This [website](https://www.ndwalkthroughs.ca/) was created by a fan, for the fans. It's filled with information on all the games that HeR Interactive released and shelved.

YouTube ▶︎ [Nancy Drew Walkthroughs](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOFbrznge6tmwLbTiaMgfjQ) - Hi! I'm Huw, and this is a channel devoted just to walkthroughs of the video games by Her Interactive

aka Huw Miller or [legofreak689](https://www.reddit.com/user/legofreak689/ )on reddit
